intro: Professionals and everyday users convert tablespoons (us) (tbsp) to milliliters (mL) when working across us_customary and metric standards in culinary recipe scaling, beverage bottling, laboratory reagent preparation, and fluid tank capacity sizing. One tablespoon (us) equals 14.786765 milliliters, while 1 milliliter equals 0.067628 tablespoons (us). Whether you are verifying volume & liquid specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial Liquid Volume Trap
items: US Customary and UK Imperial liquid units share identical names but have different physical volumes: 1 US Gallon is 3.78541 L (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial Gallon is 4.54609 L (160 Imp fl oz) — a 20.1% difference.

Similarly, 1 US Pint contains 16 US fluid ounces (473.18 mL), while 1 British Imperial Pint contains 20 Imperial fluid ounces (568.26 mL). Always verify whether your recipe, pump datasheet, or vehicle spec sheet uses US or UK standards.

faqs.question: How many milliliters (mL) are in 1 tablespoon (us) (tbsp)?
faqs.answer: There are 14.78676478 milliliters (mL) in 1 tablespoon (us) (tbsp), which rounds to 14.7868 mL for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 milliliter equals 0.067628 tablespoons (us).

faqs.question: How do I convert tablespoons (us) to milliliters (tbsp to mL)?
faqs.answer: To convert tablespoons (us) to milliliters, use the formula: mL = tbsp × 14.78676478. For example, converting 3 tbsp gives 44.3603 mL.

faqs.question: What is 3 tablespoons (us) in milliliters?
faqs.answer: 3 tablespoons (us) (tbsp) equals exactly 44.3603 milliliters (mL) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
